blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: PART XXVII - The Body as the Heart of Bhairava
blocks.directed: The Body as the Heart of Bhairava

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta has finished sixteen explanations of the divine seed. Now he turns toward the human body and asks a rather dangerous question: what if the very thing you've been treating as a miserable, temporary meat-prison is actually a complete manifestation of Bhairava?
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta has finished sixteen explanations of the divine seed. Now he turns toward the human body and asks a rather dangerous question: what if the very thing you've been treating as a miserable, temporary meat-prison is actually a complete manifestation of Bhairava?

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Childhood, youth, old age, death and rebirth. Breath flowing in and out. The subtle body's eightfold machinery. The different levels of the knower. Fourteen faculties. Forty principles. Eighty configurations. Fifteen lunar days. Eleven Rudras. Three divisions of time. And somehow, one hundred and twelve mysterious points of the embodied Heart.
blocks.directed: Childhood, youth, old age, death and rebirth. Breath flowing in and out. The subtle body's eightfold machinery. The different levels of the knower. Fourteen faculties. Forty principles. Eighty configurations. Fifteen lunar days. Eleven Rudras. Three divisions of time. And somehow, one hundred and twelve mysterious points of the embodied Heart.

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Then the philosophical argument gets properly scandalous. Wine, bodily secretions, ritual purity, forbidden substances, social custom, religious injunctions and the difference between genuine recognition and merely frightening yourself with your own concepts.
blocks.directed: Then the philosophical argument gets properly scandalous. Wine, bodily secretions, ritual purity, forbidden substances, social custom, religious injunctions and the difference between genuine recognition and merely frightening yourself with your own concepts.

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: And finally, Kālī arrives to devour the very power of limitation.
blocks.directed: And finally, Kālī arrives to devour the very power of limitation.
